Moses / Watkins Auto Parts — Vehicle Registration — GTA 6 guide

Confirmed by multiple launch guides · not personally verified Watkins Auto Parts, Port Gellhorn, Kelly County

A Port Gellhorn mechanic can make a stolen car legally yours — the first one is on the house.

Full guide — contains spoilers

Vehicle registration unlocks in the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), reached after Girl's Trip, playing as Lucia. Moses registers tracker-free stolen cars: drive in, respray, then choose Register — the first registration is free, later ones cost a fee based on the car's value. He will not register cars with Standard or Advanced Trackers, and he refuses vehicles stolen too close to his garage. Registered cars can be stored, delivered by app and recovered if destroyed.

Source & evidence

Source: GTA VI: How to Register Personal Cars and Vehicles — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Evidence: Registration walkthrough read in full.. Flow confirmed post-launch, including the required respray before registering and Moses storing up to 3 vehicles. Registration fees vary by vehicle; expensive sports cars can cost over $20,000.
